name: General Drinks
description: American Bartenders Training Manual — foundational cocktails, highballs, sours, two-liquor drinks, and shots from bartending school

drinks.name: Martini
drinks.base: 2oz Gin or Vodka, depending on customer preference
drinks.glass: rock glass or cocktail glass — guest's choice
drinks.prep: Guest's choice of ON THE ROCKS (build in a rock glass over ice: dash vermouth, then liquor, garnish) or STRAIGHT UP (half-fill a mixing glass with ice, dash vermouth, liquor, stir and strain into a cocktail glass, garnish).

drinks.name: Dry/Extra Dry Martini
drinks.base: 2oz Gin or Vodka, depending on customer preference
ingredients: a few drops of dry vermouth
drinks.glass: rock glass or cocktail glass — guest's choice
drinks.garnish: olive or lemon twist, depending on customer preference
drinks.prep: Same method as a Martini, but use only a few drops of dry vermouth instead of a dash — 'dry' means less vermouth, not less liquor.

drinks.name: Dirty Martini
drinks.base: 2oz Gin or Vodka, depending on customer preference
drinks.glass: rock glass or cocktail glass — guest's choice
drinks.prep: Same as a Martini, except add a bar spoon of olive brine.

drinks.name: Gibson
drinks.base: 2oz Gin or Vodka, depending on customer preference
drinks.glass: rock glass or cocktail glass — guest's choice
drinks.prep: A Martini with a pearl onion garnish instead of an olive or lemon twist.

drinks.name: Apple Martini
ingredients: 1/2oz Apple Pucker (in place of dry vermouth)
drinks.prep: Same as a Vodka Martini, except substitute 1/2oz Apple Pucker for the dry vermouth and add a splash of sour mix.

drinks.name: Manhattan
drinks.glass: rock glass or cocktail glass — guest's choice
drinks.prep: Guest's choice of on the rocks or straight up, same method as a Martini: dash vermouth, then whiskey, garnish (build on the rocks, or stir and strain if straight up).

drinks.name: Dry Manhattan
drinks.glass: rock glass or cocktail glass — guest's choice
drinks.prep: Same as a Manhattan, but with dry vermouth instead of sweet.

drinks.name: Perfect Manhattan
drinks.glass: rock glass or cocktail glass — guest's choice
drinks.prep: Same method as a Manhattan, using a dash each of sweet and dry vermouth ('perfect' = both vermouths).
drinks.verify: The typed recipe only lists a lemon twist garnish, but a handwritten margin note on the training page adds 'cherry and lemon' — confirm whether the garnish should be cherry and lemon twist together.

drinks.name: Rob Roy/Scotch Manhattan
drinks.glass: rock glass or cocktail glass — guest's choice
drinks.prep: Same method as a Manhattan, using Scotch as the whiskey.

drinks.name: Dry Rob Roy/Dry Scotch Manhattan
drinks.glass: rock glass or cocktail glass — guest's choice
drinks.prep: Same method as a Manhattan: dry vermouth and Scotch Whiskey, lemon twist.

drinks.name: Perfect Scotch Manhattan
drinks.glass: rock glass or cocktail glass — guest's choice
drinks.prep: Same method as a Manhattan, using both dry and sweet vermouth with Scotch Whiskey, lemon twist.

drinks.name: Lemon Drop Martini
drinks.prep: Shake and strain into a sugar-rimmed cocktail glass.
drinks.verify: Two versions of this recipe exist in the training materials: the numbered lesson lists 1oz vodka and no garnish; a separate handout lists 2oz vodka with a lemon garnish. Pour count and garnish should be confirmed.

drinks.name: Chocolate Martini
drinks.prep: Shake and strain into a cocktail glass rimmed with cocoa powder.

drinks.name: Cosmopolitan
drinks.prep: Shake and strain into a cocktail glass.
drinks.verify: A separate handout lists this with 2oz vodka (not specified as citrus) instead of 1oz citrus vodka — pour count and vodka style should be confirmed. The lime garnish comes from that handout; the numbered lesson version doesn't restate a garnish.

drinks.name: Black Russian
drinks.prep: Build over ice in a rock glass: pour vodka, then Kahlua.

drinks.name: White Russian
drinks.prep: Build vodka and Kahlua over ice in a rock glass, add cream, and short shake.

drinks.name: Sombrero
drinks.prep: Build Kahlua over ice in a rock glass, fill with cream.

drinks.name: Mud Slide
drinks.prep: Build over ice in a rock glass: vodka, Kahlua, Baileys, short shake.

drinks.name: Brave Bull
drinks.prep: Build over ice in a rock glass: tequila, then Kahlua.

drinks.name: God Mother
drinks.prep: Build over ice in a rock glass: vodka, then Amaretto.
drinks.notes: Same build as a God Father, just with vodka as the base spirit instead of Scotch.

drinks.name: God Father
drinks.prep: Build over ice in a rock glass: Scotch, then Amaretto.

drinks.name: Rusty Nail
drinks.prep: Build over ice in a rock glass: Scotch, then Drambuie.

drinks.name: Stinger
drinks.prep: Build over ice in a rock glass: brandy, then white crème de menthe.

drinks.name: Vodka Gimlet
drinks.prep: Build over ice in a rock glass: vodka, then lime juice.

drinks.name: Gin Gimlet
drinks.prep: Same as a Vodka Gimlet, substituting gin for vodka.

drinks.name: Kamikaze
drinks.prep: Build over ice in a rock glass: vodka, triple sec, lime juice.
Pour whiskey into a highball glass over ice, fill with 7UP.

drinks.name: Highball
drinks.prep: Pour whiskey into a highball glass over ice, fill with Ginger Ale.

drinks.name: Rum & Coke
drinks.prep: Pour rum into a highball glass over ice, fill with cola.

drinks.name: Cuba Libre
drinks.prep: Pour rum into a highball glass over ice, fill with cola. Garnish with lime.

drinks.name: Gin & Tonic
drinks.prep: Pour gin into a highball glass over ice, fill with tonic. Garnish with lime.

drinks.name: Screwdriver
drinks.prep: Pour vodka into a highball glass over ice, fill with orange juice.

drinks.name: Fuzzy Navel
drinks.prep: Pour peach schnapps into a highball glass over ice, fill with orange juice.

drinks.name: Greyhound
drinks.prep: Pour vodka into a highball glass over ice, fill with grapefruit juice.

drinks.name: Cape Cod
drinks.prep: Pour vodka into a highball glass over ice, fill with cranberry juice.

drinks.name: Madras
drinks.prep: Pour vodka into a highball glass over ice, fill with half orange juice and half cranberry juice.

drinks.name: Sea Breeze
drinks.prep: Pour vodka into a highball glass over ice, fill half with grapefruit juice and half with cranberry juice.

drinks.name: Bay Breeze
drinks.prep: Pour vodka into a highball glass over ice, fill with cranberry and pineapple juice.

drinks.name: Malibu Bay Breeze
drinks.prep: Same as a Bay Breeze, substituting Malibu Rum for vodka.

drinks.name: Woo Woo
drinks.prep: Pour vodka and peach schnapps into a highball glass over ice, fill with cranberry juice.

drinks.name: Sex on the Beach
drinks.prep: Pour vodka and peach schnapps into a highball glass over ice, fill with half orange juice and half cranberry juice. Garnish with orange.

drinks.name: Tequila Sunrise
drinks.prep: Pour tequila into a Collins glass over ice, fill with orange juice, top with grenadine. Garnish with cherry.
drinks.verify: A separate handout lists this served in a rocks glass instead of a Collins glass — confirm which glass is current.

drinks.name: Slow Comfortable Screw
drinks.prep: Pour sloe gin and Southern Comfort into a Collins glass over ice, fill with orange juice.

drinks.name: Alabama Slammer
drinks.prep: Pour sloe gin, Southern Comfort, and Amaretto into a Collins glass over ice, fill with orange juice.

drinks.name: Bloody Mary
ingredients: Bloody Mary mix (tomato juice, celery salt, black pepper, Worcestershire sauce, Tabasco sauce for heat)
drinks.prep: Pour vodka into a Collins glass over ice, fill with Bloody Mary mix. Garnish with lime or a celery stalk.

drinks.name: Red Devil
drinks.prep: Pour all liquors and lime juice into a Collins glass over ice, fill with orange juice.

drinks.name: Mai Tai
drinks.prep: Pour light rum, Amaretto, and Triple Sec into a Collins glass over ice, fill with half orange juice and half pineapple juice, add a dash of grenadine, and float dark rum on top. Garnish with cherry.

drinks.name: Rum Punch (Rum Runner)
drinks.prep: Pour rum, Triple Sec, and grenadine into a Collins glass over ice, fill with orange and pineapple juice.

drinks.name: Planters Punch
drinks.prep: Same as a Rum Punch, substituting dark rum for light rum and adding 1/2oz sour mix. Garnish with cherry.

drinks.name: Zombie
drinks.prep: Pour both rums, crème de almond, and Triple Sec into a Collins glass over ice, fill half with orange juice and half with pineapple juice, dash with 151 rum. Garnish with cherry.
Pour orange-flavored vodka into a Collins glass over ice, fill half with orange juice and top the rest with 7 Up.

drinks.name: Pina Colada
drinks.prep: Shake or blend with ice, pour into a Collins or hurricane glass. Garnish with cherry.

drinks.name: Bahama Mama
ingredients: equal parts orange and cranberry juice
drinks.prep: Pour both rums and peach schnapps into a Collins glass over ice, fill with equal parts orange and cranberry juice. Garnish with cherry.

drinks.name: Whiskey Sour
drinks.glass: stemmed sour glass or rock glass
drinks.prep: Shake with ice and strain into a stemmed sour or rock glass. Garnish with cherry.
drinks.notes: Sours may be called for with any liquor.

drinks.name: Midori Sour
drinks.glass: stemmed sour glass or rock glass
drinks.prep: Shake with ice and strain into a stemmed sour or rock glass. Garnish with cherry.

drinks.name: Daiquiri
drinks.prep: Shake with ice and strain into a cocktail glass.
drinks.notes: Different fruits may also be used if blended.

drinks.name: Bacardi Cocktail (Pink Daiquiri)
drinks.prep: Prepare the same as a Daiquiri, using 1/2oz grenadine and Bacardi call brand rum.

drinks.name: Margarita
drinks.prep: Frost the rim of the glass with salt (optional), shake and strain. Garnish with lime.

drinks.name: Cadillac Margarita
ingredients: 1/2oz Grand Marnier (in place of triple sec)
drinks.prep: Prepare the same as a Margarita, using premium tequila and Grand Marnier instead of triple sec.

drinks.name: Tom Collins
drinks.prep: Shake briefly with ice, pour into a Collins glass over ice, fill with soda. Garnish with cherry.
drinks.notes: Collins may be called for with different liquors.

drinks.name: Long Island Iced Tea
drinks.prep: Shake briefly with ice, pour into a Collins glass over ice, fill with cola. Garnish with lemon wedge.
drinks.verify: A separate handout lists this served in a pint/beer glass instead of a Collins glass — confirm which glass is current.

drinks.name: AMF
ingredients: 1/2oz Blue Curacao (in place of triple sec)
drinks.prep: Same as a Long Island Iced Tea, substituting Blue Curacao for triple sec and 7Up for cola.

drinks.name: Sloe Gin Fizz
drinks.prep: Shake briefly with ice, pour into a Collins glass over ice, fill with soda. Garnish with cherry.

drinks.name: Electric Lemonade
drinks.prep: Shake briefly with ice, pour into a Collins glass over ice, fill with 7 Up. Garnish with lemon wedge.

drinks.name: Old Fashioned
ingredients: bar spoon sugar or dash simple syrup
drinks.prep: Build sugar (or simple syrup) and bitters in a rock glass, add whiskey, fill with club soda. Garnish with cherry.
drinks.verify: A separate handout also lists an orange garnish alongside the cherry, and a handwritten note says to muddle the orange wedge first before adding ice — confirm the current build with the bar.

drinks.name: Mojito
ingredients: 1 bar spoon sugar or simple syrup
drinks.prep: Muddle lime wedges and mint leaves with sugar (or simple syrup) in a Collins or rock glass (no ice yet), add rum, fill with ice, splash of soda.

drinks.name: Caipirinha
ingredients: 1 bar spoon sugar or simple syrup
drinks.prep: Same as a Mojito, leaving out the mint leaves and substituting Cachaca (a Brazilian liquor) for rum.

drinks.name: White Wine Spritzer
drinks.prep: Build in a white wine glass over ice: half white wine, half club soda. Garnish with lemon twist.
drinks.notes: May also be called for with red wine.

drinks.name: Wine Cooler
drinks.base: red or white wine, half glass
drinks.prep: Build in a wine glass over ice: half wine, half 7 Up. Garnish with lemon twist.

drinks.name: Kir
drinks.glass: white wine glass or flute glass
drinks.prep: Build white wine and crème de cassis in a white wine or flute glass.

drinks.name: Champagne Cocktail
ingredients: sugar cube or bar spoon of sugar
drinks.prep: Place a sugar cube (or bar spoon of sugar) and a dash of bitters in a champagne flute, top with champagne. Garnish with lemon twist.

drinks.name: Mimosa
drinks.prep: Build in a champagne flute: half orange juice, half champagne.

drinks.name: Bellini
drinks.prep: Build in a champagne flute: half champagne, half peach nectar.
drinks.notes: The original recipe calls for Prosecco, an Italian white sparkling wine, instead of champagne.

drinks.name: Irish Coffee
ingredients: a few drops of Green Crème de Menthe
drinks.prep: Pour Irish whisky and sugar into a coffee glass, fill with coffee, top with whipped cream, add a few drops of green crème de menthe.

drinks.name: Mexican Coffee
drinks.prep: Same as an Irish Coffee, substituting Kahlua for Irish whisky and leaving out the sugar.

drinks.name: Keokee Coffee
drinks.prep: Pour brandy, Kahlua, and sugar into a glass, fill with coffee.
drinks.verify: Glass isn't restated for this entry — it's grouped under 'Coffee Drinks' alongside Irish and Mexican Coffee, which both specify a coffee glass, so it's likely the same, but confirm with the bar.

drinks.name: Jamaican Coffee
drinks.prep: Pour rum, Tia Maria, and sugar into a glass, fill with coffee.
drinks.verify: Glass isn't restated for this entry — grouped under 'Coffee Drinks' alongside Irish and Mexican Coffee, which both specify a coffee glass. Confirm with the bar.

drinks.name: Shirley Temple
drinks.prep: Pour grenadine into a highball glass over ice, fill with 7 Up. Garnish with cherry.

drinks.name: Mickey Mouse
drinks.prep: Pour grenadine into a highball glass over ice, fill with cola. Garnish with cherry.

drinks.name: Red Headed Slut
drinks.glass: small rock glass or shot glass
drinks.prep: Shake with ice and strain into a small rock or shot glass.

drinks.name: Jolly Rancher
drinks.glass: small rock glass or shot glass
drinks.prep: Shake with ice and strain into a small rock or shot glass, fill with cranberry juice.

drinks.name: Washington Apple
drinks.glass: small rock glass or shot glass
drinks.prep: Shake with ice and strain into a small rock or shot glass.
drinks.verify: A separate handout specifies Crown Royal by name instead of generic whiskey — confirm which brand is expected.

drinks.name: Strawberry Blonde
drinks.glass: small rock glass or shot glass
drinks.prep: Shake with ice and strain into a small rock or shot glass.

drinks.name: Lemon Drop
drinks.glass: small rock glass or shot glass
drinks.prep: Shake with ice and strain into a small rock or shot glass. Dip a lemon wedge in sugar and serve on the side.
drinks.notes: Distinct from the Lemon Drop Martini — this is the shooter version, served with a sugared lemon wedge on the side rather than a sugar rim.

drinks.name: Liquid Cocaine
drinks.base: equal parts 151 Rum, Rumple Minze, Jagermeister
drinks.glass: small rock glass or shot glass
drinks.prep: Shake with ice and strain into a small rock or shot glass.

drinks.name: 3 Wise Men
drinks.base: equal parts Johnny Walker, Jack Daniels, Jim Beam
drinks.glass: small rock glass or shot glass
drinks.prep: Shake with ice and strain into a small rock or shot glass.

drinks.name: Purple Hooter
drinks.base: equal parts Vodka, sour mix, Crème de Cassis
drinks.prep: Shake with ice and strain.
drinks.verify: Glass isn't restated for this entry, but every other drink in this section uses a small rock or shot glass — confirm with the bar.

drinks.name: Slippery Nipple
drinks.glass: small rock glass or shot glass
drinks.prep: Build Sambuca and Baileys in a small rock or shot glass, add one drop of grenadine.

drinks.name: Oatmeal Cookie
drinks.glass: small rock glass or shot glass
drinks.prep: Shake with ice and strain into a small rock or shot glass.

drinks.name: Oreo Cookie
drinks.glass: small rock glass or shot glass
drinks.prep: Shake with ice and strain into a small rock or shot glass.

drinks.name: Blow Job
drinks.prep: Layer equal parts Baileys and Kahlua in a shot glass, top with whipped cream.
drinks.verify: Glass isn't restated for this entry — other shot sections use a small rock or shot glass, presumed the same here.

drinks.name: Buttery Nipple
drinks.prep: Layer equal parts Butterscotch Schnapps and Baileys in a shot glass, add a drop of grenadine.
drinks.verify: Glass isn't restated for this entry — presumed shot glass, confirm with the bar.

drinks.name: Brain Hemorrhage
drinks.prep: Layer equal parts Baileys and Peach Schnapps in a shot glass, dash with grenadine.
drinks.verify: Glass isn't restated for this entry — presumed shot glass, confirm with the bar.

drinks.name: Orgasm
drinks.prep: Layer equal parts Kahlua, Baileys, and Amaretto in a shot glass.
drinks.verify: Glass isn't restated for this entry — presumed shot glass, confirm with the bar.

drinks.name: B 52
drinks.base: equal parts Kahlua, Baileys, Grand Marnier
drinks.prep: Layer equal parts Kahlua, Baileys, and Grand Marnier in a shot glass, pouring each over the back of a bar spoon, heaviest first.
drinks.verify: Glass isn't restated for this entry — presumed shot glass, confirm with the bar.

drinks.name: Cum In A Hot Tub
drinks.prep: Layer equal parts vodka, Frangelico, Jagermeister, Midori, and cream in a shot glass.
drinks.verify: Glass isn't restated for this entry — presumed shot glass, confirm with the bar.

drinks.name: Surfers On Acid
drinks.prep: Layer equal parts Jagermeister, coconut rum, and pineapple juice in a shot glass.
drinks.verify: Glass isn't restated for this entry — presumed shot glass, confirm with the bar.

drinks.name: Cherry Bomb
drinks.prep: Drop a shot of Cherry Schnapps into a glass of energy drink.

drinks.name: Jager Bomb
drinks.prep: Drop a shot of Jagermeister into a glass of energy drink.

drinks.name: Vegas Bomb
drinks.prep: Combine the Crown Royal and Butterscotch Liqueur in a shot glass, drop into a glass of energy drink.

drinks.name: Sake Bomb
drinks.prep: Drop a shot of sake into a glass of beer.

drinks.name: Irish Car Bomb
drinks.base: 1/2 Bailey's Irish Cream, 1/2 Irish Whiskey (in a shot glass)
drinks.prep: Fill a shot glass half with Bailey's Irish Cream and half with Irish Whiskey, then drop it into a 3/4 pint of Guinness beer.

drinks.name: Cabernet Sauvignon
drinks.base: Dark, ripe fruits, black cherry, plum, spice, vanilla, cedar or oak from barrel-aging
drinks.prep: Body: Heavy. Pairs with grilled and roasted meats — beef, lamb.
drinks.notes: Notable growing regions: grown in every wine-producing country, with well-known styles from California and France (Bordeaux).
drinks.verify: This is a wine study card, not a mixed drink — the source doesn't document a serving glass, rim, garnish, or service method the way it does for cocktails.

drinks.name: Pinot Noir
drinks.base: Red fruits, bright cherries, strawberry, some spice, vanilla
drinks.prep: Body: Light. Pairs with light, flavorful meats — duck, pork, chicken thighs; mushrooms; salmon and heavy-flavored fish.
drinks.notes: Notable growing regions: France (Burgundy), California, Oregon, Australia (Yarra Valley), New Zealand (Otago Valley), Italy (Northern).
drinks.verify: This is a wine study card, not a mixed drink — the source doesn't document a serving glass, rim, garnish, or service method the way it does for cocktails.
